name: Esufey Wings
body:
A pair of wings made from elemental essence grows from your back.

Prerequisite(s): Character level 10th, esufey.

Benefit: You gain two glowing elemental wings that grant you a fly speed of 30 feet (average maneuverability) if you’re wearing light armor and unencumbered, or 20 feet (poor maneuverability) with a medium or heavy load or medium or heavy armor. Fly is a class skill for you.
